Verify Otp

Verify 6-digit OTP and authenticate user.

  • Compares submitted OTP against stored bcrypt hash.
  • Enforces 10-minute expiry and max 5 verification attempts.
  • Marks OTP as consumed on success (single-use, prevents replay).
  • Links/creates User profile in database.
  • Issues JWT access token accepted across all backend endpoints.
Authorizations:
BearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
phone
required
string (Phone)

10-digit Indian phone number

otp
required
string (Otp)

6-digit verification code

Responses

https://news-backend-sjw6.onrender.com/api/v1/auth/verify-otp

Delete User Me

Permanently delete the current user's account and all their generated content:

  1. Social posts, post likes, comments, and post images.
  2. Newspaper clippings, exported PNG/PDF assets, and custom templates.
  3. Usage analytics, payment references, and OTP verifications.
  4. Local user record from public.users.
  5. Supabase profiles and auth.users entry.
Authorizations:
BearerAuth

Responses

uploads

Upload Image

Secure Image Upload (SEC-005, SEC-011, SEC-012).

  • Requires authenticated user JWT.
  • Validates actual file bytes, dimensions, and magic headers using Pillow.
  • Enforces strict 10MB size limit.
  • Segregates storage by user ID.
Authorizations:
BearerAuth
Request Body schema: multipart/form-data
required
file
required
string <application/octet-stream> (File)

Publish a newspaper clipping to the public 'Spot News' community feed. Triggered when the user/reporter clicks 'Post on Spot'.

BearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required

headline
required
string (Headline)
content

string (Content)
Language (string) or Language (null) (Language)
Default: "te"
Category (string) or Category (null) (Category)
Default: "General"
Location (string) or Location (null) (Location)
Png Url (string) or Png Url (null) (Png Url)
Pdf Url (string) or Pdf Url (null) (Pdf Url)

Default: []

Get Spot Feed

Get the public 'Spot News' social media community feed. Returns posts with realtime likes/comments counts and personalized is_liked status.

BearerAuth
query Parameters
page
integer (Page) >= 1
Default: 1

Page number

limit
integer (Limit) [ 1 .. 50 ]
Default: 10

Items per page

Category (string) or Category (null) (Category)

Filter by category (e.g. Breaking, Politics, Crime, Sports)

Language (string) or Language (null) (Language)

Filter by language code

Location (string) or Location (null) (Location)

Filter by district/city

Verify Otp

Verify 6-digit OTP and authenticate user.

  • Compares submitted OTP against stored bcrypt hash.
  • Enforces 10-minute expiry and max 5 verification attempts.
  • Marks OTP as consumed on success (single-use, prevents replay).
  • Links/creates User profile in database.
  • Issues JWT access token accepted across all backend endpoints.
Authorizations:
BearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
phone
required
string (Phone)

10-digit Indian phone number

otp
required
string (Otp)

6-digit verification code

Responses

https://news-backend-sjw6.onrender.com/api/auth/verify-otp

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "phone": "string",
  • "otp": "string"
}

Response samples

  • 200
  • 422
Content type
application/json
{
  • "success": true,
  • "message": "OTP verified successfully",
  • "token": "string",
  • "token_type": "bearer",
  • "user": {
    • "id": "string",
    • "phone_number": "string",
    • "email": "string",
    • "full_name": "string",
    • "plan": "free",
    • "is_active": true
    }
}

Upload Image

Secure Image Upload (SEC-005, SEC-011, SEC-012).

  • Requires authenticated user JWT.
  • Validates actual file bytes, dimensions, and magic headers using Pillow.

  • Segregates storage by user ID.
